why_the_contingencies_were_not_completed: Researcher decision of 2026-08-21, taken on the evidence below. Both registered contingencies address truncation. The v4r-medium run failed criteria 4 and 5 as well, and those two failures are behavioural rather than budgetary: the judge recounted the answer on A despite being instructed not to, and did not engage with the wordless-answer rule at all. A larger cap or a shorter reasoning chain does not address either. The contingencies remain registered and available; they were not tried, and this record says so rather than implying they were.
